title: The Spacecraft Still Flying After Leaving the Solar System
claim: Voyager 1 is over 15 billion miles from Earth and its radio signal now takes more than 22 hours to arrive.

title: Glass Can Shatter Just From a Sound Wave
claim: A sound wave at the exact resonant frequency of a glass can shatter it without any physical contact.

title: Why Your Shadow Can Move Faster Than Light
claim: A shadow cast across a large enough distance can sweep faster than light speed without breaking physics, since it carries no information.

title: The Footprints on the Moon Will Outlast Humanity
claim: Apollo astronaut footprints on the moon could remain visible for millions of years because there's no wind or water to erode them.

title: Earth's Oceans Could Boil Away in a Billion Years
claim: As the sun slowly brightens, Earth's oceans are predicted to evaporate completely in roughly one billion years.

title: A Day Used to Be Only 19 Hours
claim: Earth's days were just 19 hours long for over a billion years because the moon was closer and spun the planet faster.

title: Lightning Is Hotter Than the Surface of the Sun
claim: A single lightning bolt reaches temperatures five times hotter than the sun's surface for a fraction of a second.

title: The Mountain That's Still Growing Every Year
claim: The Himalayas rise a few millimeters every year because India is still crashing into Asia.

title: Why Astronauts' Blood Floats Backward in Space
claim: In microgravity, blood pools toward an astronaut's head instead of their feet, puffing up their face within hours.

title: A Planet Made Entirely of Diamond Might Exist
claim: Astronomers found an exoplanet so carbon-rich that scientists believe large portions of it could be solid diamond.
